json.name: Resprited Item/Trinket Icons
json.author: Unknown
json.description:
A simple resprite mod intented to overhaul the little icons associated with each item and trinket in order to give them a little more flair and (hopefully) make them easier to identify.

Currently, this mod only covers base game items/trinkets. Please list any mods of your choosing that you would like to see resprited icons for below, as mod support will be arriving eventually!
